metadata.remarks:
Identity Privileged Access defines the capability to control, monitor, and constrain the use of elevated or administrative identities. Privileged access introduces heightened risk and therefore requires additional safeguards, oversight, and accountability.

Governance and Responsibility Anchor:
This pattern is the authoritative anchor for roles and responsibilities, SSPPs, standards, procedures, guidelines, and assurance activities related to privileged identity usage. Controls are intentionally scoped to specific privileged access sub-capabilities.

components.title: Privileged Identities
components.description: Definition and management of identities designated for elevated or administrative access.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Manage and restrict privileged accounts separately from standard user accounts.
Apply least privilege principles to privileged identities.

components.title: Temporary Elevation
components.description: Time-bound and purpose-specific elevation of privileges for identities.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Grant privileged access only for approved time windows and purposes.
Require enhanced authentication for privileged elevation.

components.title: Privileged Session Control
components.description: Monitoring and control of sessions initiated using privileged identities.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Control initiation, duration, and termination of privileged sessions.
Record and centrally manage privileged session activity.

components.title: Enhanced Accountability
components.description: Strengthened accountability and non-repudiation for privileged identity actions.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Generate detailed audit records for privileged actions.
Support analysis and correlation of privileged activity.
